history.summary: UNVERIFIED RECORD: No web source identifies a 'Markandey Mahadev Temple' in Purnia district, Bihar. The only well-documented Markandey Mahadev Temple is at Kaithi, Varanasi, Uttar Pradesh (not this record). Founding date, history, architecture and exact location are all unverified; this file is a thin placeholder. Coordinates are approximate Purnia-city values only, and no reliable image of a Purnia temple of this name was found after searching.

name: Markandey Mahadev Temple
town_description: Purnia (also Purnea) is a city in northeastern Bihar and the headquarters of Purnia district and division. An educational and commercial hub of the Seemanchal-Kosi region, it is nicknamed 'Mini Darjeeling' and takes its name from goddess Puran Devi (Puran Aranya).

travel.airport: Nearest commercial airport: Bagdogra (IXB), about 160-170 km by road; Purnia's own airport is under development (verify).
travel.railway: Purnea Junction, a major railhead, lies within the city (verify).
travel.road: NH 27 and NH 31 pass through Purnia; city reachable by bus, auto-rickshaw and taxi (verify).
